facts.fact: Tris 与 Four 在起火的大楼里蹲低前行，远处金属隔断墙正一扇扇落下，把火隔开。
facts.anchor: I hear slamming in the distance as other metal walls come down

facts.fact: 墙后有人喊：有个女孩被关在他们这一侧的安全室里，墙落下时外面的人正想找人来放她出来。
facts.anchor: Stuck in the safe room on your side

facts.fact: Four 说他熟悉这栋楼的走法，因为几次恐惧模拟泄露了犯罪信息，他必须出庭作证。
facts.anchor: When they reveal information about criminal behavior, I have to testify about what I’ve seen

facts.fact: Tris 凭「安全室就在听证该举行的位置」断定门后是 Mae。
facts.anchor: Who else would have been locked in a safe room right where the hearing is supposed to be?

facts.fact: 门楣上方有一扇小气窗，多数人钻不过去，Tris 钻得过去。
facts.anchor: Above the door is a small transom window.

facts.fact: Tris 翻越气窗时背后热浪扑来，肩膀被灼伤。
facts.anchor: White-hot pain sears into my shoulder

facts.fact: Four 问她是抱着走还是自己走，她心里想答应，最后摇头。
facts.anchor: The idea of him carrying me makes something twist in my stomach

facts.fact: 父亲朝她走来，她想起他曾去记忆库要求抹掉她的记忆，于是转过身避开他。
facts.anchor: I think of him telling the Memory Vault to take my memory

facts.fact: Christina 拉开外套给她看藏在里面的 Fox 旗。
Mae 与 Mender 的母亲出现，要他们离开她的孩子，Four 挡在她面前拖延。
facts.anchor: “Get away from my child,” a woman’s voice says
